parsed.rationale: Both members are unnamed extensions on `UserDefaults` within the same `Caching` package, living in two separate files (`UserDefaults+WXYC.swift` at line 15 and `DefaultsStorage.swift` at line 47). Consolidating both into `UserDefaults+WXYC.swift` (the file whose name already signals its purpose) would centralise all `UserDefaults` customisation for the `Caching` package in one place.
